LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1_RWP.label: Thompson M1
LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1_RWP.description: A classic submachine gun known for its reliability and iconic design, the Thompson M1 fires .45 caliber rounds with a high rate of fire. While it excels in close-quarters combat with its rapid burst capability, its effective range is limited. A solid choice for any colonist looking to lay down suppressive fire or engage foes at short range.
